listed_quote.quote: Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (NYSE: TTP), Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NYSE: NDP),

announcement.quote: Tortoise announced today that following a strategic review of the funds, the Board of Directors has approved a proposal to merge Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NDP) with and into Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (TTP).

deals.notes: Joint proxy DEF 14A filed 2021-02-23; special meeting set for April 7, 2021, then adjourned to June 4, 2021 (DEFA14A 2021-04-06, accession 0001140361-21-011832). No excerpt states how the vote or merger ended. Later filings (2021-05-25, 2022-06-24, 2022-08-05) are annual-meeting proxy materials listing NDP as a separate company; they do not state the merger outcome.
